task: HashLife: memoised quadtree Game of Life with RLE I/O, naive oracle, invariant checker, compaction
reasoning_summary: Represent the universe as hash-consed immutable quadtree nodes and compute the centre half after 2^j generations with Gosper's recursive scheme, memoised per node. Step by decomposing n into powers of two, expanding the root until live cells sit in the centre quarter. Verified against a naive sparse-set oracle, published Life facts (R-pentomino 116 cells at gen 1103, glider after 2^40 generations, Gosper gun glider count) and a corruption test per invariant rule.
